# Standards Gate Requirements Quality Checklist: Repo Standards Alignment

**Purpose**: Validate the quality, clarity, and completeness of the standards-audit
gate requirements (FR1–FR6) — not the implementation.
**Created**: 2026-08-30 (reviewed 2026-08-30 per /spec.implement gate)
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)
**Domain**: standards-gate

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/spec.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 - Is the repo-profile enum (`app-k8s` | `app` | `library`) fully specified with the mandated check set for each profile? [Completeness, Spec §FR2] — profiles + per-check adaptation specified; `app`/`app-k8s` require Dockerfile, `app-k8s` adds `k8s/*.yaml` + manifest-policy, secrets applies to all
- [x] CHK002 - Is the documented-exemptions mechanism for the secret scan specified (entry format, allowlist file, review path)? [Gap, Spec §FR2] — now specified: `--allowlist <FILE>` (pattern per line, `#` comments/justification), format pinned in `contracts/cli.md`
- [x] CHK003 - Is the behavior for zero-violation vs mixed-result vs all-fail output states defined in the aggregate summary contract? [Edge Case, Spec §FR3] — defined in `contracts/cli.md`: `AUDIT RESULT: PASS/FAIL (n pass, n fail, n n/a)` + exit 0/1/2; fixtures cover PASS, FAIL, N/A
- [x] CHK004 - Is the required-processing of the standards-audit results as a required PR check and scheduled conformance sweep covered by requirements? [Coverage, Spec §FR3] — FR3 names both; T013 (PR caller) + T031 (sweep caller) defined
- [x] CHK005 - Is the action required when the declared profile's inputs are missing (N/A) specified for every check type, not just structure? [Completeness, Spec §FR2] — FR2 global rule: "A check with no applicable inputs … reported as N/A, never as a fail"

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK006 - Is the Git-tracked-files-only secret-scan surface unambiguous relative to the full working tree? [Clarity, Spec §FR2, Clarifications 2026-08-30] — Q3 answer recorded; `git ls-files` surface
- [x] CHK007 - Is the best-effort `.env` fallback unambiguous for port / PVC / image-tag / cronjob conflicts (authoritative vs cross-manifest consistency)? [Clarity, Spec §FR2] — Q4 answer + FR2 split (format vs value-level) make it unambiguous
- [x] CHK008 - Is the exact content/format of `.template-version` stamping defined (constant source, idempotency, commit-safety)? [Clarity, Spec §FR4] — canonical `init/template-version` ("1.0.0"), idempotent, committed (readme/T015–T020)
- [x] CHK009 - Is "well-formed" for each structure check defined with concrete criteria (parseable YAML, valid `.env`)? [Measurability, Spec §FR2] — `.env` parseable `name=value`; `k8s/*.yaml` parse as YAML

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK010 - Do the "no new runtime dependency" Success Criterion and the Pending Decision Log constraint agree on Copier/Cruft being deferred-only? [Consistency, Spec §SC, §Constraints] — SC5 + PDL constraint both defer Copier/Cruft to P3 RFC
- [x] CHK011 - Are BSD/GNU portability and `set -euo pipefail` conventions stated consistently across structure, secrets, and manifest-policy checks? [Consistency, Spec §Constraints] — single project-conventions constraint governs all checks + plan triage
- [x] CHK012 - Is the additive-only constraint applied to every affected subsystem (init.sh, cicd-tests, README) without exception? [Consistency, Spec §Constraints, §Delta] — SC6 + additive constraint + Delta MODIFIED list consistent

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK013 - Can the conformant-fixture PASS outcome be objectively observed without a cluster, Docker, or network (offline determinism)? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §FR5, §Demo] — Demo Sentence + offline bats fixtures (noenv/env/library)
- [x] CHK014 - Is every failing-check output requirement tied to an actionable remediation (Gate Ergonomics) in the acceptance baseline? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §FR6] — FAIL lines must carry `fix:`; asserted in bats

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK015 - Are requirements specified for a non-conformant fixture that fails every check type, and for a profile-mismatched repo? [Coverage, Spec §FR5] — non-conformant fixture fails all; profile-mismatch covered via N/A semantics (declared profile inputs absent → N/A, never FAIL)
- [x] CHK016 - Are requirements specified for a repo whose generated `k8s/` manifests differ from `.env`, in both `.env`-present and `.env`-absent cases? [Edge Case, Spec §FR2] — Q4 + FR2 authoritative/fallback; fixtures: env-present agree (T027), env-mismatch (T006), noenv fallback (T005)
- [x] CHK017 - Are P2/P3 boundary assumptions documented so P1 does not lock in decisions contradicting the Pending Decision Log? [Assumption, Spec §Constraints] — PDL constraint + RFC-scoped P2/P3 in plan/tasks

## Dependencies & Governance

- [x] CHK018 - Is the tag/SHA pinning requirement documented for all reusable-workflow references (no @main-style unpinned refs)? [Dependency, Spec §SC, §Constraints] — SC7 + conventions constraint + T012/T014
- [x] CHK019 - Is the OIDC / no-long-lived-credentials security requirement propagated to both the workflow and local-runner modes? [Consistency, Spec §Constraints] — audit is offline/deterministic (no cloud access); workflow least-privilege `permissions: contents: read`, no secrets

## Traceability

- [x] CHK020 - Is a requirement/check ID scheme established (FR1–FR6, SC1–SC7) and consistent across spec, plan, and this checklist? [Traceability, Spec §FR] — FR/SC IDs consistent across spec/plan/tasks/checklists; check + task IDs sequential

## Report

- **Checked items**: 20/20 | **Traceability**: 20/20 (100%) ≥ 80% minimum.
- **Gaps resolved during review**: CHK002 (exemptions mechanism added to Spec §FR2), CHK015 (profile-mismatch via N/A semantics), CHK004 (sweep-mode caller T031), CHK005 (N/A scoped to all checks).
